title: Wave motifs
slide_intent: Separate static and animated asset routes because production format determines which original a designer needs.
strategic_value: Named wave variants can help Helsinki contributors select consistent assets across print and moving media.
demonstration: This webpage component links SVG/InDesign vector originals and animated wave motifs, then lists six names: Basic, Calm, Pulse, Beat, Vibration and Wave.
practical_value: Choose the appropriate asset route and use the names to identify the required variant.

content_islands.name: Download routes
content_islands.spec: Place the vector and animated links below the format description.

content_islands.name: Variant key
content_islands.spec: Follow with the numbered six-name list.

reference_purposes.Application: The component provides separate vector-original and animation downloads and a six-variant key.
